description: Scan the conventional CDP debug ports (9222-9225 by default) for already-running, debuggable Electron apps on loopback only. No session required. Returns: { ok, targets, count, scanned } where each target is { targetId, port, appName, pid } and scanned reports { host, ports, elapsed_ms } so an empty result is unambiguous. Errors: BAD_ARGUMENT (non-loopback host, invalid port list, or timeout outside bounds). A failed probe is simply "no target on that port".

host.description: Loopback host to scan. Defaults to 127.0.0.1.

ports.description: Ports to scan. Defaults to 9222-9225. Max 64.

timeoutMs.description: Per-port timeout in ms. Defaults to 300. Max 5000.

name: electron_discover_running
title: Discover running Electron apps
